quotes.text: evidence: [evidence.id], quotes: [{ id: evidence.id, text }], status: "provisional", supersedes: []

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: For enabled project identities, publishProjectLessons creates new shared summary evidence and a provisional shared lesson. It keeps original lesson and private evidence IDs for audit. Raw private evidence and its exact private quotes stay local. A published summary is not independent verification. This is the console publication behavior, not a claim that the original interpretation is correct.
title: Publish useful private-source project claims as separate provisional lessons
